description: The right panel of Figure 5 illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values below a threshold of 1e-3, plotted against the layer index. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," is scaled from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gating (average 0.03), which remains low and relatively flat near zero across all layers; an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gating (average 0.44), which starts near 1.0 at layer 0 and decreases to approximately 0.25 by layer 22; and a green dash-dot line for the sparsity ratio after average gating (average 0.33), which also begins near 1.0 and declines to about 0.1 by layer 22. All three lines show a general downward trend as layer depth increases, with the post-gating lines exhibiting significantly higher sparsity than the pre-gating line.
